blocks.text: This video shows an animated background behind the text of a landing page. A grid of dots glows under drifting lights, and the text stays on top. Our landing hero has a title, a line of text, and a button. Let's put the animation behind them.

blocks.alt: It comes first in the hero, so the text is drawn over it. The file repeats forever, so the lights keep drifting.

blocks.text: It comes first in the hero, so the text is drawn over it. The file repeats forever, so the lights keep drifting. Let's look at the styles that place it.

blocks.alt: The backdrop fills the whole hero, behind everything else. The file itself is set to cover its box, like a background image.

blocks.text: The backdrop fills the whole hero, behind everything else. The file itself is set to cover its box, like a background image. So, an animation can be a background like any image. One line puts it in, and a few styles keep it behind your content.
